capabilities.operation: simulate(Grid, absolute_index_callback_or_Waveguide, complex_array_or_launch_callable): Fourier transverse Laplacian, classical four-stage fourth-order RK4 along z, every-step transverse field history by default, amplitude/phase preservation without normalization; numeric NPZ export refuses overwrite. check_convergence rebuilds launch and geometry on half-step, half-spacing and enlarged-window grids. No UI/device/Agent dependency.
capabilities.verification: 2026-10-31: retained RK4 scientific checks plus grid validation; package-only entry and installed-wheel E2E. See docs/reports/python-only-20261031.md. Historical initial validation: docs/reports/rk4-package-20261030.md.
capabilities.limitations: All demo physical parameters assumed_not_measured. Scalar forward weak-index paraxial model, one/two transverse dimensions, periodic boundary, no absorber/reflection/polarization/nonlinearity/CAD import/calibration or registered Agent tools. Explicit RK4 has a conservative grid-dependent step bound and is not exactly unitary. All positions means discrete grid nodes; 16 million stored complex values, max 100000 steps. Trusted coordinate callbacks must be deterministic and resolvable; discontinuities can reduce convergence order. Supplied field units determine intensity/power units.
